What Is a Road Hazard?

A road condition that presents a danger while driving, may require changes to your speed or steering, and could contribute to an accident.

  • PotholeA hole in the road surface.
  • CraterAn exceptionally large/deep pothole.
  • Pot BumpA raised patch caused by poor road repairs.
  • RoadworksA section of road dug up, excavated, cut, or scraped for construction or repairs.
  • Rocky RoadA rough or stony road surface.
